collection.description: Someone has been leaving fresh flowers on the old mud hut, and a Heathen finally sees who.

description_variants.description: Someone has been leaving fresh flowers on the old mud hut, and an Isolan finally sees who.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Someone has been leaving flowers on the roof of the old mud hut. Fresh ones, every morning, tucked into the thatch. (name1) is the one who finally sees who it is, just before dawn: an old Heathen woman, reaching up on her toes with a fistful of red blossoms. She sees (name1) and does not seem at all embarrassed.

variants.text: Someone has been leaving flowers on the roof of the old mud hut. Fresh ones, every morning, tucked into the thatch. (name1) is the one who finally sees who it is, just before dawn: an old Isolan woman, reaching up on her toes with a fistful of red blossoms. She sees (name1) and does not seem at all embarrassed.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: "For my sister," she says. "She used to fix this roof. She was the only one who could ever get it to stop leaking." She hands (name1) half the flowers. From then on there are two bunches on the roof every morning.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (name1) says nothing, just holds the ladder steady. The old woman tucks the flowers in, pats the thatch twice, and climbs down. "Same time tomorrow," she says, as though (name1) has always helped. (name1) is there the next morning, and the morning after that.
